_readme: Examples for connecting an MCP client to Roblox Studio's built-in MCP server (studio/mcp.md). Copy ONE variant's mcpServers block into your client's config. The server name must be exactly Roblox_Studio. For Claude Code prefer Quick connect or the CLI commands under claudeCodeCli (scope local). Do not commit a root .mcp.json; it is OS-specific and gitignored.

claudeCodeCli.windows: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local Roblox_Studio -- cmd.exe /c %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat
claudeCodeCli.macos: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local Roblox_Studio -- /Applications/RobloxStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/StudioMCP
